    > Operations & Procurement Coordinator

    Bulwarx, a leading cybersecurity integration company, is
    looking for an Operations Coordinator to join our growing team!
    This is a diverse and dynamic role in the fields of operations, procurement, and sales.
    Location: Ra’anana
    Full-time position (with flexibility for part-time)

    Responsibilities:

    ​

    • Manage and process customer orders from initiation to fulfillment

    • Translate client needs into accurate, execution-ready orders

    • Prepare tender responses and related documentation

    • Responsible for issuing customer invoices and overseeing collections.

    • Handle day-to-day tasks within the sales department.

    • Partner cross-functionally with sales and technical teams, while maintaining strong relationships with vendors and customers.

    Required Skills and Experience:

    ​

    • ​Proven experience in sales operations/procurement/Finance department (including handling price quotes and leads)

    • Strong proficiency in MS Office – required

    • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and methodical

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

    • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative team-player attitude

    • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities

    • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines during peak periods

    • Background or knowledge in accounting and collection – advantage

    •  Experience working with Priority ERP system – advantage

    > Professional Services Engineer

    We're looking for a talented Professional Services Engineer.

    Professional Services Engineers are responsible for making our most strategic customers successful.

    You will lead short / long term projects at the client location and install our solution.

    This team solves real world problems, using brand new technology in the cyber industry.

    Responsibilities:

    ​

    • Perform technical integration activities of the existing platform.

    • Perform end-to-end test to verify the integration for product owner sign off.

    • Business analysis to ensure that product owners requirements are clearly understood.

    • Provide updates to Project Managers regarding the status of your project -deliverables.

    • Support operational team with integration and new requirements launches.

    Required Skills and Experience:

    ​

    • One year plus of experience in technical integration\ system administration \system\IT\post sale activities.

    • Strong professional interpersonal and communication skills.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

    • Proven ability in delivering exceptional customer experience.

    • English skills both written and verbal.

    • Advantage: Experience in cyber industry.

    • Advantage: Experience in CyberArk\Forcepoint\MFT products.

    > Support Engineer

    We're looking for a talented and motivated Support Engineer to join our team. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, identifying issues, and delivering professional service to our customers.

    Responsibilities:

    ​

    • Providing remote Tier 3 support for our embedded information security solutions to ensure exceptional service delivery to our valued customers.

    • Identifying and efficiently resolving technical issues with a high level of professionalism, ensuring optimal client satisfaction.

    • Collaborating closely with the IT and information security teams of our clients, fostering strong working relationships, and meeting their specific needs.

    • Acquiring an in-depth understanding of security solutions from various manufacturers, enabling you to offer specialized expertise and guidance to customers.

    Required Skills and Experience:

    ​

    • 1-2 years of relevant experience in System/IT.

    • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling effective interactions with clients and internal teams.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

    • Prior experience in customer service, demonstrating your ability to provide top-notch support and build positive relationships.

    • The ability to perform well under pressure and meet demanding deadlines, ensuring seamless support even during challenging situations.

    • English skills both written and verbal.

    • Experience working in a large organization - Advantage.

    > Enterprise Sales Manager

    Bulwarx is seeking a motivated Sales Manager for our growing sales team!

    You will be maintaining strong relationships with Bulwarx customers, identifying opportunities, and achieving organizational goals by effectively selling the company's products and tailoring them to meet customer needs.


    There are two open positions: Enterprise Sales Manager and Commercial Sales Manager

    Responsibilities:

    ​

    • Successfully close E2E sales cycles

    • Identifying potential customers

    • Leading sales meetings with customers

    • Achieve the sales goals successfully

    • Understanding and familiarity with the company's products

    • Establish and cultivate relationships with customers

    Required Skills and Experience:

    ​

    • Two years plus of experience as a Sales Manager

    • Previous experience as an Enterprise Sales Manager or Commercial Sales Manager is an advantage

    • Work experience in integration companies

    • Work experience with leading Cyber Security vendors

    • In-depth knowledge of network security solutions from global vendors

    • Work experience with SME/Enterprises customers

    • Experience in leading internal organizational processes

    • Team player

    • Excellent organizational skills and experience working with CRM systems

    • Significant advantage: Work experience in selling information security products
